faqs.answer: You can find all current job openings and apply through the 'Careers' section on the official BCCL website. Keep an eye out for official notifications.
The current Chairman cum Managing Director (CMD) of BCCL can be found on the 'About Us' page of the official website.
All open tenders are published on the government's e-procurement portal and are linked from our 'Tenders' page.
BCCL's headquarters is located at Koyla Bhawan, Koyla Nagar, Dhanbad, Jharkhand - 826005.
BCCL is committed to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and undertakes various projects in education, healthcare, and community infrastructure. More details are on our website.
